snapshot.title: UAS-02 Flyaway Protocol — Tower Coordination

lines.text: Harwick UAS Operations Group to HWK Tower: UAS-02 has lost link and is unresponsive. We are initiating the flyaway protocol per HUOG-FOM 9.2. Requesting immediate coordination.
Harwick UAS, this is HWK Tower. We have you on 462.2625 MHz. Acknowledged, initiating airspace coordination. Please confirm aircraft status and last known position.

fields.voiceStyle: Young adult female, calm, clipped, professional

snapshot.instructorNote: This is a critical command transmission to external authorities. The IC must confirm receipt and log the time. The ASO must begin FSDO reporting immediately.
